meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 当 Claude 启用此技能后,它会将原始数据组织成有故事性的叙述,包括开头、冲突、结局。提供三种故事框架(问题-解决方案、趋势、比较),并生成带可视化的演示或报告,如高管摘要幻灯片、数据故事流程等。
howto.when: 当你要求把分析结果做成给高管、投资者或非技术受众看的汇报、数据报告或演示时触发,例如写季度业务回顾、构建投资者演示等。

say.text: 把这份销售数据用趋势故事讲给管理层听
say.note: Claude 会按 Trend Story 框架组织叙事。

say.text: 帮我做一页式的月度业务回顾仪表盘故事
用对比框架分析该先进入 EMEA 还是 APAC
say.note: 会产出 Comparison Story 和市场评分矩阵。

howto.what_en: Guides Claude to turn raw data into narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. It offers story frameworks, visualization techniques, and presentation templates (executive summary, dashboard story, etc.) to produce report-ready output.
howto.when_en: Triggered when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations. Typical entry points: quarterly reviews, investor decks, or communicating insights to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Present this sales data as a trend story for management.
say_en.note: Claude will structure it using the Trend Story framework.

say_en.text: Create a one-page monthly business review dashboard story.
say_en.note: It will generate the One-Page Dashboard Story template.

say_en.text: Compare EMEA vs APAC entry using the comparison framework.
say_en.note: It will produce a Comparison Story with a weighted scoring matrix.
